text: In XXXX I opened a joint account with my wife at the time with Wells Fargo Bank. We divorced in XXXX at which time she was responsible for the Wells Fargo account per the divorce decree. Checking my credit files with the three major credit bureaus this information from Wells Fargo is still being reported on my credit reports. I spoke with a representative at Wells Fargo on XX/XX/XXXX and we closed the joint account. The representative told me that the account will still be reported on my credit reports. If for whatever reason my ex decides not to pay or pays late this information will also be reported on my credit report. Although I dont anticipate my ex not paying it because she has paid it consistently for years it is still an outstanding balance and it is adversely affecting my credit score. The reason why I believe it is adversely affecting my credit score is because she makes the minimum payment. Recently, I always pay my credit card balances in full each month. I am trying to achieve the highest credit score possible. This Wells Fargo account is hampering my ability to achieve that goal.
